title: useReducerHistory
description:
Implement an undo/redo history hook using `useReducer`. It tracks a stack of past values and supports moving backward and forward through history.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo } = useReducerHistory(0);
set(1); set(2);
undo(); // value === 1
redo(); // value === 2
```
ai_context: Common mistake: not clearing the future stack when set() is called after an undo. Also: off-by-one errors when slicing the past array for undo.
